p: as: One hundred and thirty years after the flood.
they journeyed from the: That is, Nimrod and his company.
east: That is, from Armenia where the ark stayed.
Shinar: Which was afterward called Chaldea.
build us a city and a: They were moved with pride and ambition, preferring their own glory to God's honour.
came down to see the city: Meaning, that he declared by effect, that he knew their wicked enterprise; for God's power is everywhere, and neither ascends nor descends.
Behold: God speaks this in derision, because of their foolish persuasion and enterprise.
let us go down: He speaks as though he took counsel with his own wisdom and power: that is, with the Son and holy Spirit: signifying the greatness and certainty of the punishment.
there confound their language: By this great plague of the confusion of tongues appears God's horrible judgment against man's pride and vain glory.
of Shem: He returns to the genealogy of Shem, to come to the history of Abram, in which the Church of God is described, which is Moses' principle purpose.

Abram: He makes mention first of Abram, not because he was the first born, but for the history which properly belongs to him. Also Abram at the confusion of tongues was 43 years old, for in the destruction of Sodom he was 99 and it was destroyed 52 years after the confusion of tongues.
Iscah: Some think that this Iscah was Sarai.
Terah took Abram his son: Though the oracle of God came to Abram, yet the honour is given to Terah, because he was the father.
Haran: Which was a city of Mesopotamia.
